legend: Pigmented lesion of the mons in a 39-year-old woman. The junctional component of this compound melanocytic proliferation is composed predominantly of nests located at the tips and sides of epidermal rete ridges (the melanocytic nests bridge across adjacent rete) and a few single cells, in association with concentric eosinophilic fibroplasia; the junctional component extends beyond the dermal melanocytes (moderate architectural disorder), and there is moderate cytological atypia. The majority of the dermal melanocytes are relatively smaller than the junctional melanocytes and show progressive maturation with dermal descent.

Pigmented lesion on the left side of the vulva in a 36-year-old woman. This predominantly junctional melanocytic proliferation is characterized by intraepithelial proliferation of single small to medium-sized melanocytes, distributed primarily along the basal layer of stratified squamous epithelium with retained rete architecture and inconspicuous confluence or pagetoid distribution, consistent with a predominantly junctional dysplastic naevus with severe architectural disorder and moderate cytological atypia.

The junctional component is composed of predominantly nests located at the tips and sides of epidermal rete ridges (the melanocytic nests bridge across adjacent rete) and a few single cells, in association with concentric eosinophilic fibroplasia; the junctional component extends beyond the dermal melanocytes (moderate architectural disorder) and moderate cytologic atypia. Majority of the dermal melanocytes are relatively smaller compared to the junctional melanocytes and show progressive maturation with dermal descent.

Pigmented lesion on the left side of vulva in a 36-year-old woman. The lesion is characterized by predominantly intraepithelial proliferation of single small to medium-sized melanocytes, distributed primarily along the basal layer of stratified squamous epithelium with retained rete architecture and inconspicuous confluence or pagetoid distribution, consistent with predominantly junctional dysplastic nevus with severe architectural disorder and moderate cytologic atypia.
